description: Defines the MediaFoundationTexturePool class for managing a pool of D3D11 textures used in media rendering on Windows, including related structures, callback types, and internal data management.

classes.name: MediaFoundationTexturePool
classes.description: Manages a pool of D3D11 textures for video frame rendering, including initialization, acquisition, and release of textures.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the texture pool with a specified size and frame dimensions, calling a callback upon completion.

methods.name: AcquireTexture
methods.description: Retrieves a texture from the pool along with its associated token.

methods.name: ReleaseTexture
methods.description: Releases a texture back into the pool using its token.
